app.title: AHub — Agriculture Hub
app.tagline: Connecting Rwanda's Agriculture, Knowledge, and Markets
portals.rab.title: RAB Administrator Portal
portals.rab.description: Manage official prices, national announcements, province accounts, and catalogs.
portals.province.title: Province Veterinary Portal
portals.province.description: Monitor disease outbreaks, approve district accounts, and coordinate provincial programs.
portals.district.title: District Veterinary Portal
portals.district.description: Coordinate district campaigns, approve sector accounts, and triage case escalations.
portals.sector.title: Sector Vet & Agronomist Portal
portals.sector.description: Register sector farmers, conduct farm visits, triage local issues, and publish sector notices.
portals.nsg.title: NSG Platform Security Portal
portals.nsg.description: Monitor active sessions, inspect audit logs, and manage technical security incidents.
portals.farmer.title: Farmer Portal
portals.farmer.description: Track production cycles, daily tasks, regional weather, problem reports, and sell produce.
portals.customer.title: Customer / Buyer Portal
portals.customer.description: Post product demand requests selecting items and target regions, and discover local supply.
auth.selectPortalToRegister: Select portal to apply for an account
auth.approvalNotice: Official accounts require approval from the immediate parent authority level before activation via a 1-time access code.
auth.farmerOtpNotice: Farmers log in securely via Phone Number + SMS OTP code.
auth.customerNotice: Customers self-register directly using Email/Phone and Password.
